render_method: Microsoft Word Page.EnhMetaFileBits; GDI PlayEnhMetaFile rasterization at 200 DPI; PDF assembled from reviewed page images of the same saved DOCX.
visual_review: All 44 page images inspected across final render iterations; no clipped text, overlapping tables or missing figures observed.

limitations: PDF dạng ảnh 200 DPI, không có lớp văn bản tìm kiếm; Word ExportAsFixedFormat bị treo.
